name: prompter-android
description: Android and iOS builds of the Vāk Sārathī teleprompter

scripts.build:apk: npm run sync && cd android && export JAVA_HOME="/Applications/Android Studio.app/Contents/jbr/Contents/Home" && ./gradlew assembleRelease && mkdir -p ../../dist && cp app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk ../../dist/VakSarathi.apk && echo Built dist/VakSarathi.apk
scripts.build:debug: npm run sync && cd android && export JAVA_HOME="/Applications/Android Studio.app/Contents/jbr/Contents/Home" && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.build:ios: npm run sync:ios && xcodebuild -project ios/App/App.xcodeproj -scheme App -configuration Release -destination generic/platform=iOS -derivedDataPath ios/build -allowProvisioningUpdates build
